data.one_liner: Provides a Flutter widget to integrate Google reCAPTCHA v3 on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: The plugin loads a WebView that renders the reCAPTCHA v3 challenge and returns a token after execution. Developers can then verify the token on their backend using Google’s verification API.
use_when: You need to protect form submissions or sensitive actions from bots in a Flutter mobile app
You want a simple way to obtain a reCAPTCHA v3 token without building a custom WebView solution
avoid_when: You target platforms other than Android or iOS (e.g., web, desktop)
You require a fully native CAPTCHA implementation without WebView
strengths: Handles token generation and provides easy getter
Supports custom hosted index.html for production URLs
weaknesses: Relies on WebView, which may affect performance
Only works on mobile platforms; no web/desktop support
